U017: obstacle interpretation for safe placement remains an explicit existing rule question.
D050: actual map-marker entities are outside the current six-hero content; not silently represented as minions.

No proof for every possible reachable information set; finite scenario/field coverage and fail-closed schemas are evidence, not a proof that an unreviewed new mechanism is understood.
Public history is not compressed; no learned long-history memory has been validated.
